description:
Delete `domain::latest_gate_run`, whose only caller was the run-scanning reuse lookup.

## Background

`domain::latest_gate_run` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:1030-1040`) picks the most recently started run from a list. Its only callers were the backends' reuse scans, which reuse no longer runs: reuse reads one verdict record.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `domain::latest_gate_run` and its tests no longer exist, and no selection of a latest run over a list of runs remains in `domain/types.rs`.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: The run-scanning latest selection is gone
